Name: AUDR by Chargebee
Tagline: Open standard for tracking agent run costs
Description: AUDR (Agent Usage Detail Record) is an open standard, for capturing who initiated an agent run and what it cost across every system that run touches. Inspired by the telecom industry's Call Detail Record, AUDR defines a common JSON schema that any harness, router, or billing system can emit and ingest. Three core rules make it work: a shared run ID minted by the harness, clear field ownership, and strict merge rules where conflicts are rejected and corrections are new records.

Name: Rill Browser
Tagline: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
Description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

Name: Fuse AI
Tagline: Build a Custom GTM Stack. One SDK. One MCP.
Description: Your GTM stack shouldn’t need a dozen tools, subscriptions, and APIs. Fuse gives developers and AI agents one SDK and MCP for the entire workflow. Think OpenRouter x Apollo x Clay x Zapier. Fuse takes care of web automations, data enrichment, multi-channel outreach, workflows, and AI agents. Build unlimited workflows and agents on top, without stitching together separate GTM products for every step.

Name: OpenBot
Tagline: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer
Topics: Productivity, Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: OpenBot is an open-source workspace for AI teammates. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode, or custom agents on Mac, Windows, and iOS. Give agents clear roles, let them delegate work, and invite your team to collaborate live with the same agents.

Name: Incredible
Tagline: The AI that does the clicking and typing for you
Topics: Productivity, Artificial Intelligence, Menu Bar Apps
Description: Incredible is an AI for your Mac or PC that does the tasks you would otherwise click through yourself. Hold a key and say what you need, like "enter the orders from this sheet into our supplier portal". For bigger jobs you see the plan first. Incredible then works in your own browser, where you're already signed in, and asks before anything is sent or deleted. You get a short report when the work is done, and tasks can repeat on a schedule. Free for 14 days.

Name: Pheebs
Tagline: Measure how engineers and teams actually work with AI
Topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub, Data & Analytics
Description: Measure how you and your team actually work with AI coding agents. Pheebs is an open-source AI telemetry tool created by Eversynced. It sits quietly inside Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via hooks, capturing lightweight interaction signals: the shape of the session, not its contents.

Name: Coddy
Tagline: Learn to code 20+ languages in a fun way with short lessons
Topics: Android, Education, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Coddy teaches you to code with short, interactive lessons you actually finish. 20+ languages (Python, JS, C++, SQL, Rust, Go...), a real code editor in the browser with test cases, streaks, weekly leagues and Bugsy - an AI tutor that gives hints, not answers. Everything is free with a daily limit, on web, iOS and Android. 5M+ learners so far. Product Hunt visitors get 50% off any plan for 72h, applied automatically.

Name: ruOS
Tagline: A cloud desktop where AI agents do the work for you
Topics: Productivity, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: ruOS is a private cloud desktop with an AI team built in. Ask for research, writing or code and the agents (Claude Code, Codex, ruflo swarms) do it while you watch or step away. Opens in any browser on Mac, iPad or Chromebook, nothing to install. Files and AI memory persist across devices. Power users get a real Linux box plus an MCP server, so ChatGPT or Claude can drive it. Try ruOS Lite free in seconds, no sign-up.

Name: Willow Knowledge
Tagline: Your AI already knows you. Now Willow can too.
Description: Willow Knowledge lets you bring your writing style and personal context into Willow from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or any AI you use. It's like giving superpowers to Willow Scribe. From now on, your email, slack msg, prompt, or wherever you write will sound exactly like you when you dictate.

Name: Extrovert
Tagline: Run LinkedIn outreach from your agent
Description: Extrovert finds prospects, suggests who to comment on or DM today, and prepares drafts in your voice. Review in 20 minutes a day, or hand the whole job to your Claude.

Name: OrgComputers
Tagline: Workspace for your AI Agents
Description: OrgComputers is a shared workspace for your AI agents. Projects, context and tools in one place, so Claude Code, Cursor and Codex start with what your team already knows.

Name: mcpgawk
Tagline: Catch MCP servers that change after you approved them
Description: An MCP server can change what its tools do after you approved it. Your agent will call the new one and never notice. mcpgawk records a baseline of every MCP server your agents use, checks behaviour in a sandbox, and sits in the path: once a tool's description or power changes, the call is refused until you decide. The agent cannot approve its own way past it. Everything runs on your machine. Nothing is uploaded. Free CLI, VS Code extension and MCP server. The gateway tier has a 7-day trial.

Name: NoteWorthy
Tagline: Notes supercharged with AI, all on-device
Description: Yet another notes app with AI? Nah. This one is supercharged, and the AI never leaves your device. Jot anything down and NoteWorthy titles it and files it under Tasks, Ideas, Info, Personal or your own labels. One tap turns a messy brain-dump into clean headings and checklists. Long note? Summed up in a line. It all runs on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. Works offline, no account, no subscription, and not a single note sent to a server. Free. ⚡️

Name: Ari Helper 7
Tagline: Private AI assistant, now with photo and film studios
Description: Ari Helper 7 is a private AI assistant for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. New since the last launch: Photo Studio (heal, repair, denoise, colorize, upscale 4x, on device and inside Photos), Film Studio for shot-by-shot films and video clean-up, a live camera you can ask questions, on-device image generation, and your own OpenAI-compatible servers. Apple Intelligence, Gemma 4 or cloud keys you own. One $24.99 purchase, no subscription.

Name: EasyCut
Tagline: Edit your Claude motion videos
Description: EasyCut turns Claude-made motion videos into a fully editable timeline. Every title, scene, image, sound and element is kept on its own track, so you can select anything and ask Claude to change just that part without rebuilding the whole video. Adjust timing, add your brand, fit music to the edit, create smooth slow-mo, resize for different platforms and export when you're done. Free in your browser. Your files stay on your device.

Name: Ghostifier
Tagline: Companies have your data. Ghostifier gets them to delete it.
Description: Instead of one form per company, Ghostifier starts from your inbox. It finds who holds your data, unsubscribes you and opts you out of sale and sharing on day one, waits out the return window, then sends deletion requests and tracks every reply. Banks, insurers and your employer are left alone. It also asks data brokers to delete you. Gmail access is headers only, so it never reads your email bodies, and there is no AI: every decision follows fixed rules.

Name: MeetNote
Tagline: AI meeting notes for Google Meet, no bot joins your call
Description: MeetNote writes a live transcript of your Google Meet calls in Chrome's side panel, then gives you a summary, decisions and action items when the call ends. No bot, no sign-up. Notes stay in your browser, and you pick the AI or run it on-device.

Name: Appto
Tagline: An iOS app factory that runs on your own AI subscription
Description: Appto is an iOS app factory for your Mac. It finds a niche where apps already make money, comes up with the app, designs and codes it, builds the App Store page with screenshots and ASO copy in every language, fills in App Store Connect and sends it to Apple when you say go. After launch it shows every sale live, answers reviews, tracks keywords and suggests fixes. It runs on your Claude Code or Codex plan, so there are no token bills. I'm not a developer and shipped 10 apps with it.

Name: Brnch
Tagline: Modern code hosting for the agent era
Description: Brnch is code hosting for how we build now: you and your coding agents in the same repo. It's Git underneath (for now), so your tools still work. Each agent gets its own identity and works under you as its sponsor, so you can see exactly what it did, down to the line. Every merge is tested on the exact result that lands, not just the branch, and comes with a signed receipt anyone can verify. To start, tell your agent: "Set me up on Brnch: brnch.io"

Name: Chunk
Tagline: The time-blocking app for macOS
Description: A time blocking app for Mac that puts your tasks and calendar in one place. Drag a task onto your day and it becomes a block, and a countdown shows how long is left on it. Syncs both ways with Google, Outlook and Apple Calendar, and pulls in Apple Reminders. Save a good day as a template, or ask Claude to plan your week. Your data stays on your Macs and syncs through your own iCloud. No subscription, 7 days free no card required.
